name: EGFR-mutant lung cancer: resistance to osimertinib
question: New evidence on how EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer becomes resistant to osimertinib, how often each mechanism occurs, and what works after resistance.
primary_query: (EGFR[tiab] OR "ErbB Receptors"[mh]) AND (osimertinib[tiab] OR AZD9291[tiab] OR Tagrisso[tiab]) AND resistan*[tiab]
secondary_query: ("Drug Resistance, Neoplasm"[mh] OR "acquired resistance"[tiab] OR "disease progression"[tiab] OR progressed[tiab]) AND ("third-generation"[tiab] OR "third generation"[tiab] OR T790M[tiab] OR C797S[tiab] OR "EGFR-TKI"[tiab] OR "EGFR TKI"[tiab]) AND (NSCLC[tiab] OR "lung cancer"[tiab] OR "lung adenocarcinoma"[tiab])

criteria.text: Concerns EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: patients, tumour samples, cell lines or animal models.
Involves osimertinib (also called AZD9291 or Tagrisso), alone or in combination.
Reports on resistance to osimertinib: a mechanism, how often a mechanism occurs, or treatment after resistance.
Reports original data (trial, cohort, case report, laboratory study) rather than being only a review, editorial or guideline.

fields.text: The resistance mechanism the paper describes, genetic or not, in the paper's words, e.g. MET amplification, ERK/GATAD2A/SAA1 axis, histological transformation.
Specific genetic alteration(s) reported, as written in the paper, e.g. EGFR C797S, MET amplification. Null if the mechanism is not a genetic alteration.
Context of the alteration, e.g. in cis or in trans with T790M, co-occurring alterations.
Treatment line or setting, e.g. first-line osimertinib, after progression.
Study design, e.g. retrospective cohort, phase 2 trial, case report, cell-line study.
Number of patients, if stated. Digits only.
What kind of finding the paper reports. Exactly one of the allowed values.
The main result in one sentence, staying as close to the paper's wording as possible.

high_impact.why: A result on what to give after resistance can change treatment, so a person always reads it. Mechanism papers are checked like any other and reach a person when a check fails.
